detailed_description: TikTok Hashtag Generator creates hashtag combinations from a content topic, video type, target audience, and optional keywords. The real component separates viral-style tags from niche long-tail tags and provides a copy-all action for drafting captions. It does not connect to TikTok, inspect trending data, publish posts, or guarantee reach.
usage_steps: Choose the content type and audience.
Add optional keywords you want reflected in the tag set.
Review the viral and niche hashtag groups, then copy the set for editing in your caption.
usage_examples: Draft hashtags for a tutorial, product demo, or creator update.
Mix broad discovery tags with more specific niche tags.
Compare tag ideas for the same topic across different audiences.

faqs.question: TikTok Hashtag Generator is free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tool runs free in the browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Does the tool upload my inputs?
faqs.answer: No. The calculation or generation runs locally in the browser.

faqs.question: Does it use live TikTok trend data?
faqs.answer: No. It uses local template logic and your inputs. Check current platform trends yourself before publishing.

faqs.question: Does it post to TikTok?
faqs.answer: No. It only generates hashtag text that you can copy and edit.
